annotations.title: Read a page as an AI assistant does

description: Read a web page the way an AI assistant does: the HTML its server sends (no JavaScript), converted to Markdown by the same converter MakerRadar uses to answer `Accept: text/markdown`, with its heading outline, word count, whether the content only appears once JavaScript runs, and whether the page itself answers with Markdown. The Markdown is capped at 20,000 characters. It fetches that one page as our crawler (MakerRadarBot), after the site's robots.txt, and stores nothing; the text is the site's own, unverified. at most 20 checks an hour per network and 30 an hour per site checked.

url.description: The public page to check (https://…). A bare host means its homepage.

name: read_page_as_markdown

checks.description: Fails first. `fix` is the one action to take; null on a pass.

facts.description: What was read, as labelled rows. From the site or a registry: unverified.

listing.description: Whether the site is listed on the directory: its page when it is (and claimUrl while nobody has proven they own it), where to list it when not.

toolUrl.description: The same check as a page on the site.

title: Read a page as an AI assistant does
